terra.problem: The wording applies God’s acceptance to both parties, but verse 3 specifically says God has accepted the one who eats.
The verses say the person who observes a special day does so to the Lord; they do not say this about the person who considers every day alike.
The verses do not say that the distress caused by eating is the reason to stop judging one another.
The verses concern eating or drinking that causes a brother to stumble, not simply a brother stumbling for any reason.
